$comment: LIVE PILOT config (ADR-0019): REAL orders on Kraken, $20 principal, ONE position at a time, Baseline4h (a known no-edge strategy: the point is validating the real-exchange plumbing, not profit). Boots PAUSED (initial_state) and Conductor alone starts it (ADR-0018). Selected only by infra/docker-compose.live.yml via scripts/trading-mode.sh; never run it by hand. The API key reaches the container as FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY/SECRET env vars, never this file. available_capital is 19, not the 20 USD principal: Kraken charges the entry fee on top of the order cost, so staking the whole balance would be rejected for insufficient funds; the 1 USD gap is the fee reserve.

order_types.$comment: Limit entry/exit prefers maker fills ('Order preference' in docs/04-architecture/execution-freqtrade.md). LIVE ONLY: stoploss_on_exchange is true (ADR-0019). Freqtrade 2026.8's Kraken class supports it with order types 'market' (Kraken stop-loss, triggers a market sell) and 'limit' (stop-loss-limit); 'market' is used so the stop always fills. It works with the strategy's custom_stoploss: the exchange order is created when the entry fills at the initial stop and replaced once, after stoploss_on_exchange_interval, by the ATR stop (which then never moves). 10 s keeps the window where the exchange holds only the wide initial stop short; the replacement costs two Kraken calls once per trade.

telegram.$comment: DISABLED in work package 3A-4 (ADR-0015). Conductor owns the Telegram bot now, with a chat-ID allowlist and confirmed writes; Freqtrade's own bot had ~35 commands (/forceexit, /stop, /reload_config, ...) reachable by anyone in the configured chat and no way to restrict them. With enabled=false none of those commands exist. Trade open/close notifications now come from Conductor (ingest).

api_server.$comment: Bound to 0.0.0.0 inside the container; infra/docker-compose.yml publishes it to the host as 127.0.0.1:8080 only. Credentials are blank here and injected at runtime via FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__* env vars (see .env.example) so no secret is committed.
